signin_hint: One account for every LynkOmni place.
signin_passkey_hint: Your phone or computer confirms it is you. No password to remember.
signin_pin: Enter your PIN on an enrolled phone
signin_new_device_note: New device or place? We tell you on every channel, with no link in the message.
contact_hint: We sent a 6-digit code. It expires in 10 minutes.
passkey_hint: A passkey replaces a password. Add one on this device now; add a second device soon.
recovery_code_hint: Shown once. Write it on paper and keep it away from your phone. It is never sent to you again.
recovery_code_push: Next: enrol a second device or a co-owner today. It is the fastest way back in.
recover_question_device: Do you have another phone or computer where you are signed in?
recover_question_code: Do you have your recovery code?
path_device_body: Open LynkOmni on the other device and approve with its PIN. You are back in at once.
path_code_body: Enter both codes. Then a 24-hour wait: every enrolled device and your backup contact are told, and any of them can cancel.
path_assisted_body: An ID document, proof of the business and a live check. Then a 72-hour wait and approval by two staff members. Never over a phone call.
recovery_cancel_note: Any enrolled device or your backup contact can cancel this.
recovery_restricted: After recovery this device is restricted for 24 hours: no role or payout changes, no removing other devices, no export.
never_allowed: Never: SMS alone, security questions, a reset over the phone, email alone.
username_change_note: Your old username keeps pointing to you and never goes to anyone else.
keep_one_passkey: Keep at least one passkey. Add another before removing this one.
stepup_hint: A fresh check is needed for this. Enter the code we sent.
last_owner_note: The last owner cannot leave. Transfer ownership first.
wallet_empty: Your wallet is empty. Tickets, vouchers, eSIM codes and points from every shop appear here.
no_plans: Every plan is on Free. Nothing to pay.
memberships_body: LynkBooking and LynkEssential memberships appear here when you join one.
download_hint: Ready within 30 days, then available for 7 days.
close_hint: 30 days to change your mind. Your LynkID is never given to anyone else.
close_requested: Closing on {when}. Sign in before then to keep it.
security_always: Security alerts always come through, with no link in them.
exchange_link: Exchange activity is in LynkOmni Exchange.
payslips_empty: No payslips yet. They appear here when an employer pays you through LynkOmni.
standing_intro: A standing payment is your own instruction: a cap you set, held by the licensed provider, and you are told every time it is used.
start_intro: Register a business, get a tax number and open a business bank account through the government gateway and banks in your country. Free for you; government fees go straight to the government.
start_submitted: Submitted. The authority decides; we show its answer here.
start_approved: Approved. Your business {lynkoid} is ready in LynkOmni.
start_not_before: Nothing is approved until the authority says so.
notice_signin: New sign-in on an unknown laptop
notice_consent: Sharing with your accountant ends in 7 days
help_article_1: Lost your phone? How recovery works
screens_hint: Pick a screen. Sign-up, sign-in and recovery follow the agreed rules: passkeys first, SMS never enough alone, a waiting period people can cancel.
ws_help: The same books, invoices, contacts and reports for yourself, a company or an organisation.
ws_note: Same prices and rules for everyone. No till needed.
sf_age: A Storefront is for people aged {age} or older, or the age of majority where they live.
sf_identity_sent: Sent to the partner. You will be told when they answer.
sf_identity_why: Before your first paid offer, the licensed payment partner checks who you are. Free offers can go up without it.
sf_intro: Offer your products, services, lessons or files to everyone and get paid through licensed payment partners. Your Storefront uses this same account.
sf_plan_line: {plan}: {share} of each Storefront sale, taken by the payment partner
signup_adult: I am {age} or older, or the age of majority where I live
signup_adult_note: We never ask for your birth date.
support_side_note: Questions about selling, offers, buyers and payouts go to seller support. Your priority is the highest of all your plans.
trips_intro: Share a trip with people you choose, for a set time. It ends by itself, and you can stop it at any moment.
share_none: You are not sharing with anyone.
share_visible: You always see who you share with. Nobody else sees where you are.
plan_intro: Set when you expect to arrive. If you do not check in by then, your trusted contacts are told, even if your phone is off.
plan_done: Checked in. Your contacts will not be told.
collect_intro: Show this code at any pickup point to collect every parcel waiting for you, from any carrier.
collect_changes: The code changes every minute. Never share it in chat or by phone.
collect_once: Each parcel can be collected once.
movement_plans_note: LynkMotion is everyday tracking and LynkGuard protects vehicles and assets. Each has Free, Plus, Pro and Max.
find_two_ways: Add a second way in, so a lost phone does not lock you out.
find_advanced: Your account handles money. Consider advanced protection.
two_ways_one: You have only one way in.
lock_body: Signs you out everywhere, sends a freeze for your cards and pauses your app keys. Location shares you started keep running.
unlock_note: Unlocking needs a fresh check that it is you.
adv_body: Only passkeys sign in. Sensitive changes wait {days} days and a new phone number or email waits {days2} days.
cooloff_note: A new device signed in. Until {when}, payout changes, data downloads, contact changes and removing a passkey wait.
held_note: This waits until {when}, to keep your account safe.
staff_title: Who at LynkOmni looked at your account
staff_line: Support looked at {what} with your consent ({ref})
successor_title: Someone to look after your account
successor_note: If you are away for a long time, the person you name can ask for access. You are told first and can stop it.
contact_title: Your phone number is being changed
contact_wait: The new number applies on {when}. Your old number was told and can cancel.
signup_later: You can start now and confirm later: sales made on this device join your account after a check.
nset_paused: Paused. Security, safety and things you are waiting for still come.
nset_deputy_body: A manager gets your business notifications for up to 90 days. Security and account messages stay with you.
nset_test_sent: A test went to every channel.
credit_note: The lender's interest and fees apply.
